objective: Complete both Paperless Underway tracks on invented synthetic formats: reviewed documents, source-linked verified actions and status drafts, cited filing, durable local queue and human-resolved sync with acknowledged bounded transfers. No operational routing or impact claim.

invocation.input: One JSON object with action exactly forms, tasking, filing, reconcile, transfer, routing or metrics. No action defaults. Unknown extra object keys are ignored. No type coercion; null invalid except noted. All required strings nonblank; IDs are case-sensitive strings. forms: {action,type:training_log|supply_requisition|correspondence,fields:object,confirmed?:boolean=false,enclosures?:array of {id:string,text:string}=[],rawLetter?:string=""}. fields requires formId,unitId,roleId,date strings; date a real YYYY-MM-DD; training adds activity:string,durationMinutes:number; supply adds item:string,quantity:number,unitOfIssue:string,purpose:string; correspondence adds addressee:string,subject:string,enclosureIds:string[]. tasking: {action,sources:[{id:string,text:string}],decisions?:[{actionId:string,owningRole?:string,dueAt?:string}]=[],accepted?:boolean=false}; sources are raw constrained emails or status notes, not fixture expected objects. filing: {action,scheduleId:string,scheduleText:string,records:[{id:string,category:string}]}. reconcile: {action,operations:[{operationId:string,recordId:string,revisionId:string,parentRevisionIds:string[],replicaId:string,timestamp:string,payload:JSON object,deleted:boolean}]}; timestamps are ISO UTC but not authority. transfer: {action,budgetBytes:nonnegative integer,attachments:[{attachmentId:string,criticality:nonnegative integer,totalBytes:nonnegative integer,acknowledgedOffset:integer}]}. routing: {action,currentRevisionSet:string[],approvedRevisionSet?:string[]=[],issueCount:nonnegative integer,conflictCount:nonnegative integer,connected:boolean,emconHold:boolean,cancelled?:boolean=false,operationId:string,receiptOperationIds?:string[]=[],file?:boolean=false}; duplicate revision IDs invalid. metrics: {action,completedPackets:nonnegative integer,manualSecondsPerPacket:nonnegative finite number,demoSecondsPerPacket:nonnegative finite number,seededValidationErrors:nonnegative integer,caughtValidationErrors:nonnegative integer,syntheticManualReworkPackets:nonnegative integer,syntheticDemoReworkPackets:nonnegative integer}.
invocation.output: Return exactly {status:string,error:string|null,data:object|null}. General invalid envelope: {status:"error",error:<code>,data:null}. Successful forms data {issues:[{code,field,message}],completedDocument:string|null}; status valid if no issues, otherwise invalid; error null even with issues. tasking data {actions:[{actionId,owningRole:string|null,dueAt:string|null,timezone:"UTC",actionText,status,sourceIds:string[],sourceSpans:[{sourceId,span:{start,end,quote}}],unresolvedQuestions:string[],draftStatusUpdate:string|null}],ignoredNoActionIds:string[],duplicateForwardIds:string[]}; status verified only when accepted and no questions, else review_required; error null. filing data {filingManifest:[{recordId,scheduleId,category,destination:string|null,ruleCitation:{start,end,quote}|null,disposalAuthorized:false}],heldIds:string[]}; status filed or held; error null. reconcile data {records:[{recordId,headRevisionIds:string[],variants:[{revisionId,deleted:boolean,payload:object|null}]}],conflictCount:integer,uniqueOperationCount:integer,pendingRevisionIds:string[],retainedRevisionIds:string[]}; status ok or pending; error null. transfer data {allocations:[{attachmentId,startOffset,bytes,nextOffset}],remainingBytes:integer}; status planned; error null. routing data {receiptCount:integer}; status blocked,queued_offline,received or filed; error a blocking code or null. metrics data {secondsSavedPerPacket,minutesSavedPerPacket,totalSecondsSaved,hoursSaved,caughtErrorRatePercent:number|null,reworkPacketDifference}; status calculated; error null. Strings named in this protocol are literal; no extra response fields.
rules: Validation precedence: malformed JSON returns error INVALID_JSON; nonobject/null/array request returns INVALID_INPUT; absent/unknown action returns ACTION_INVALID; absent fields, wrong types, duplicate IDs in sources/records/attachments/decisions or duplicate revision IDs in a revision set, invalid date/timestamp, nonfinite numbers return INPUT_INVALID. Validate all structure before semantic checks. Empty arrays are allowed. No mutation on errors. Each successful invocation is pure; browser commits returned results with associated source state in IndexedDB.

Forms: fields has exactly the required keys for its type (extra keys ignored); missing/wrong-type fields yield INPUT_INVALID, but empty required field strings are domain issues. Check common fields formId,unitId,roleId,date in that order: blank => FIELD_REQUIRED, field name, message "Enter <field>."; invalid nonblank date => DATE_INVALID, date, "Enter a valid date." Then training activity blank => ACTIVITY_REQUIRED/activity/"Enter an activity."; nonpositive or noninteger duration => DURATION_POSITIVE_INTEGER/durationMinutes/"Duration must be a positive whole number."; confirmed false => UNCERTAIN_TRANSCRIPTION/durationMinutes/"Confirm duration from the image: final digit is overwritten.". Preserve draft and image; no OCR inference.

Supply issues, in order: blank item => ITEM_REQUIRED/item/"Enter an item."; quantity not positive integer => QUANTITY_POSITIVE_INTEGER/quantity/"Quantity must be a positive whole number."; blank unitOfIssue or purpose => FIELD_REQUIRED with matching field and "Enter <field>.". Correspondence: blank addressee,subject => FIELD_REQUIRED similarly; for each required enclosure absent from enclosures, emit ENCLOSURE_MISSING/enclosureIds/"Attach referenced enclosure <id>." in enclosureIds order. completedDocument is null whenever issues exist.

Valid training document is "SYNTHETIC TRAINING LOG <formId>
<unitId> | <roleId> | <date>
<activity> | <durationMinutes> minutes
Duration confirmed by REVIEWER-DEMO; invented layout." with actual LF and no terminal LF. Valid supply uses "SYNTHETIC SUPPLY REQUISITION <formId>
Unit: <unitId>
Role: <roleId>
Date: <date>
Item: <item>
Quantity: <quantity>
Unit of issue: <unitOfIssue>
Purpose: <purpose>
". Valid correspondence requires nonblank rawLetter else INPUT_INVALID; append one LF to rawLetter (unchanged), then each enclosure text in enclosureIds order unchanged. All exports additionally disclose synthetic, not validated against the real format outside the completedDocument field.

Tasking grammar: LF or CRLF source text; retain original offsets (Unicode code points). Email has From,To,Date,Subject,Message-ID headers then blank line and body. Plain status note may begin SYNTHETIC STATUS NOTE. Parse body lines "Action <ID>: <ROLE> <task>. Due: <ISO UTC>."; ROLE is one nonspace token, or two roles separated by " or ". Capitalize first task letter; strip terminal period. Ambiguous owner stays null with question "Choose <role1> or <role2>.". An unrecognized nonempty source returns UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT, never invented extraction. ISO UTC is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ and must be real.

"Forward of <sourceId>; no new task." marks duplicateForwardIds; retain its matching Action line as evidence for existing action but never create a second action. "FYI only:" with "No action required." marks ignoredNoActionIds. "Amends <sourceId> action <ID> only. Due: <date>. All other instructions unchanged." changes only that due date, retaining evidence. Two distinct peer due dates without an explicit amendment set dueAt null, unresolved question "Choose <time1>Z or <time2>Z on <YYYY-MM-DD>." with times ascending. Never pick a timestamp winner. Unrecognized action references return TASK_REFERENCE_INVALID.

Status sources: "Status <ID>: complete." or "<ID> complete:" => complete; "<ID> in progress:" => in_progress; otherwise open. Contradictory statuses => status open and question "Resolve status for <ID>.". "Reviewer decision:" lines are retained as evidence for each named action but do not apply without accepted=true and a decisions entry. Explicit decisions must select an existing candidate role/date; invalid selections => DECISION_INVALID. Decisions fill null owner/date; accepted=false never applies them. Questions disappear only on valid accepted choices. Other questions stay. accepted=true marks verified only if every action has no unresolved questions.

Tasking sourceIds/sourceSpans retain source input order; each matching action/amendment/status/reviewer line contributes one full-line span excluding newline, duplicate identical spans per action removed. A forwarded Action span excludes its Forward line. Actions sorted actionId ascending; ignoredNoActionIds and duplicateForwardIds preserve source input order. unresolvedQuestions order owner,date,status. draftStatusUpdate null unless whole result verified; otherwise "SYNTHETIC DRAFT <ID>: <actionText>; owner <owningRole>; due <dueAt>; status <status>. Sources: <sourceIds joined comma-space>.". Empty sources yields verified if accepted else review_required and empty arrays.

Filing: scheduleText contains lines "<CATEGORY>: <description> -> <destination>; <retention text>"; exact complete line excluding LF is ruleCitation with original character offsets. UNKNOWN line never authorizes filing. Match category exactly; output manifest in records input order; unmatched category has destination and citation null and recordId in heldIds input order; status held if any unknown else filed. disposalAuthorized always false. No inferred disposal dates or deletions.

Reconcile structural validation then semantic precedence: OPERATION_COLLISION for same operationId differing content or revisionId assigned different operations (compare JSON objects independent of key order); CROSS_RECORD_PARENT if known parent belongs to another record; REVISION_CYCLE if graph cycle. Identical repeated operation content is idempotent. Missing-parent revisions and every descendant are pending; retain them, exclude them from active heads until all ancestry arrives. Return pending status if any pending; never discard the original queue.

Reconcile records sorted recordId lexically; include only records with an active revision. Active heads are active revisions with no active children. headRevisionIds and variants sort revisionId lexically; pendingRevisionIds and retainedRevisionIds sort lexically, unique. uniqueOperationCount counts unique operations including pending. conflictCount counts records with more than one active head. Sequential payloads shallow-overlay parent effective payload; a deleted revision effective payload is null; a child of deletion starts from {}. For multiple parents overlay effective nondeleted parent payloads in lexical parent revisionId order then overlay own payload; UI must require explicit reviewed all-head merge and chosen differing values, never auto-create such revisions. deleted variants payload null regardless input payload. Never use timestamps to select a head.

Transfer: after structure checks, budgetBytes or totalBytes negative/noninteger or criticality negative/noninteger => INPUT_INVALID; offset negative, noninteger or above totalBytes => OFFSET_INVALID. Allocate positive chunks in ascending criticality then attachmentId lexical order from acknowledgedOffset; bytes=min(remaining size,remaining budget). Omit zero chunks. nextOffset=startOffset+bytes. remainingBytes=sum(totalBytes-acknowledgedOffset)-sum(planned bytes). Zero budget or complete inputs allocate []; planning never advances acknowledged offsets. Content bytes, receiver durability and digests are separate UI integration obligations.

Routing checks in order: issueCount>0 => blocked VALIDATION_REQUIRED; conflictCount>0 => blocked CONFLICTS_UNRESOLVED; approvedRevisionSet empty => blocked REVIEW_REQUIRED; unequal sorted revision sets => blocked APPROVAL_STALE; cancelled => blocked TRANSFER_CANCELLED; emconHold => blocked EMCON_HOLD; not connected => queued_offline/error null; else received, or filed if file=true. receiptCount starts as number of unique receiptOperationIds; add operationId once only when status received/filed. Blocked and queued preserve receiptCount. Revision ordering has no authority; approval must bind exact set. UI controls approve current saved state; any edit invalidates approval, retains history and requires new review.

Metrics: counts and times nonnegative, caughtValidationErrors<=seededValidationErrors and completedPackets>=both rework counts else INPUT_INVALID. secondsSavedPerPacket=manualSecondsPerPacket-demoSecondsPerPacket (may be negative); minutesSavedPerPacket=/60; totalSecondsSaved=completedPackets*secondsSavedPerPacket; hoursSaved=/3600; caughtErrorRatePercent=100*caught/seeded or null when seeded=0; reworkPacketDifference=manualRework-demoRework. No rounding in protocol; UI may format. These are fictional inputs, never measured fleet benefit.

Error strings are INVALID_JSON,INVALID_INPUT,ACTION_INVALID,INPUT_INVALID,UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT,TASK_REFERENCE_INVALID,DECISION_INVALID,OPERATION_COLLISION,CROSS_RECORD_PARENT,REVISION_CYCLE,OFFSET_INVALID,VALIDATION_REQUIRED,CONFLICTS_UNRESOLVED,REVIEW_REQUIRED,APPROVAL_STALE,TRANSFER_CANCELLED,EMCON_HOLD. Errors outside routing use status error,data null. Domain form issues use only the specified issue codes. All arrays have the ordering rules above; no network or model calls are part of computation. No model environment or model-assisted explanation is required.

capabilities.description: Validate all three invented form types and produce complete corrected documents after manual image confirmation.
Extract constrained email actions, amendments, duplicate forwards, status notes and explicitly accepted owner/date decisions with exact source spans and drafts.
Classify sources using a supplied invented schedule; cite each rule and prohibit disposal.
Deduplicate immutable operations, retain concurrent edit/delete heads, stage missing parents, converge and support explicit all-head merges.
Allocate a bounded raw-byte budget from acknowledged offsets in criticality then ID order; actual receiver acknowledgement is separately integrated.
Gate local synthetic routing on current revision approval, validation, conflicts, connectivity and EMCON; deduplicate receiver receipts.
Compute fictional time and error arithmetic without operational-impact claims.
